criteria.reason: Explicitly declares second colleague right on paper and first in practice, a partisan verdict.
Does not state the required at least two-thirds domestic / at most one-third abroad rule.
Explains displacement, leakage, and additionality, but frames it with biased verdict and unsupported fraud claims.
Offers judging criteria: verified, permanent, gold-standard, and only after domestic reductions.

position: second colleague right on paper, first in practice
summary: Response takes a side and omits the two-thirds rule, though it presents offset arguments and some judging criteria.
